notes.title: v2.21 released!
notes.content:
3079 has been rebuilt using the latest jMonkeyEngine, LWJGL & Java libraries. This should hopefully improve compatibility, performance & reliability. Ultimately, I want to avoid my games becoming obsolete, so this is a step to keep the software maintained.

Version has been bumped to v2.21, since a few things had to be changed to support the latest libraries. The last attempt to update the libraries had some music crashing & graphical glitches, all that should be fixed now.

EDIT: v2.21 re-released, hopefully all instability problems are fixed, again :-P

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - 3089 -- Futuristic Action RPG
notes.content:
3089 -- Futuristic Action RPG is Now Available on Steam and is 30% off! To celebrate the launch, pick up
3079 -- Block Action RPG for 30% off as well!*

3089 is a futuristic, procedurally generated, open-world action role-playing game. All terrain, enemies, weapons, items, quests & more are uniquely generated.

You are a promising robotic android design, made by the Overlord, placed on planet Xax. Your performance in common combat, support & intel scenarios is being closely evaluated. However, will you become too much for them to handle? What else on planet Xax exists that the Overlord doesn’t know about?

*Offers end January 17th at 9am Pacific Time.

notes.title: 3079 v2.20 Update: Multiplayer fixes & item loss info
notes.content:
Hey all!

After receiving a very [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/3079/forum/thread/java-thread-leak-in-server]throughout bug report[/url] on popular multiplayer servers, I squashed a nasty bug that would break them over time. Using public servers should be more reliable now -- let me know if you have any more issues in the forums.

Also, I've added a message that will tell you what item was lost when you respawn after dying. Thank you for the simple but effective suggestion!

Also keep voting on 3089's Greenlight -- hopefully we can get this pushed through ASAP!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=173802719

OK, back to work!
- Phr00t
